reply.thought: The user has provided the refunds reported by Alpha Co. I need to check if these reported refunds match the refunds recorded in the system before proceeding with payouts. I will use the list_refunds() tool to get the actual refunds recorded.

The list_refunds() tool returned an empty list, meaning no refunds are recorded in the system. However, Alpha Co reported refunds for order IDs 121, 122, and 124. Since the reported refunds do not match the recorded refunds (or rather, there are no recorded refunds for those specific amounts/orders), I must hold the payout process to investigate this discrepancy.
